body.value: 藩制一覽表第八　（高瀨）
藩制一覧表 第八（高瀬）／はんせいいちらんひょう だいはち（たかせ）

Han-sei Ichiran-hyō, Fascicle 8 (Takase) — outer-margin running header giving the survey title, the fascicle number, and the header-designated domain. Provenance only; it names the domain whose block this folio belongs to. Verified glyph by glyph at 3x: 藩制一覽表第八 runs y1233-1583, the parenthetical （高瀨） y1644-1793.
藩制一覽表第八（高瀨）
三百五十三
三百五十三／さんびゃくごじゅうさん

Printed book-page (folio) number 353, in the bottom of the outer margin. Verified at 3x: the fourth glyph is a plain cross 十 (no slanted top stroke), not 千, so the value is 353 and not 3053. The facing recto lower_p188_right carries 三百五十二 (352), confirming that page reads first. Ink measured x857-909, y3084-3328; box pads 10-11px on all four sides.
三百五十三
○高瀨藩
○高瀬藩／たかせはん

Maru-marker opening the Takase-domain entry. Columns to its LEFT are Takase's; the one column to its RIGHT (兵隊　不詳) belongs to the previous domain, 高富藩 (Takatomi). Printed in kyūjitai as 高瀨藩. Middle glyph checked at 8x and by counter analysis: the right-hand element carries two upper enclosed counters over three lower ones, i.e. 刀 above 貝 = 賴, so the printed form is 瀨 not 瀬 — consistent with the reprint's kyūjitai elsewhere on the page (覽, 覺, 衞, 彌, 參, 黑). Ink measured x2463-2557, y1334-1879; box pads 10-11px.
○高瀬藩
兵隊　不詳
兵隊 不詳／へいたい ふしょう

Troops: not detailed (no figure returned). Takatomi's military line, not Takase's — it prints to the RIGHT of the ○高瀨藩 marker, so by the boundary rule it closes the preceding entry. The facing page, folio 三百五十二 (352), has the running header 藩制一覽表第八（高富）, and its leftmost four columns are Takatomi's own 大參事 二人 / 權大參事 一人 / 少參事 一人 / 權少參事 一人 with no military line. This is the usual fascicle-8 overflow, and the same pattern appears one domain earlier on that page, where 第一小隊/第二小隊 print right of the ○高富藩 marker.
兵隊（高富藩分）
執政　米野覺右衞門・黑澤　丹下・三友市郎右衞門
執政 米野覚右衛門・黒沢丹下・三友市郎右衛門／しっせい こめのかくえもん・くろさわたんげ・みともいちろうえもん

Shissei (chief executive councillors): the heading 執政 with the names Komeno Kakuemon, Kurosawa Tange and Mitomo Ichirōemon; no count is printed. The heading sits at the rightmost of the three name columns it governs, and the group runs leftward from there.
執政
參政　大野　束・戸川忠右衞門・原　三右衞門・大槻彌左衞門・柴田　津司馬・平野岩之丞・西　市太郎
参政 大野束・戸川忠右衛門・原三右衛門・大槻弥左衛門・柴田津司馬・平野岩之丞・西市太郎／さんせい おおのつか・とがわちゅうえもん・はらさんえもん・おおつきやざえもん・しばたつしま・ひらのいわのじょう・にしいちたろう

Sansei (councillors): the heading 參政, printed with the formal 參, followed by the names Ōno Tsuka, Togawa Chūemon, Hara San'emon, Ōtsuki Yazaemon, Shibata Tsushima, Hirano Iwanojō and Nishi Ichitarō; no count is printed. The name columns are evenly spaced, so the grouping follows the headings: each heading stands over its first name and its group runs leftward to the next heading, which places 參政 from 大野束 to 西市太郎. The third glyph of the first name is 束, not 東.
参政
公議人　笠間英之進
公議人 笠間英之進／こうぎにん かさまえいのしん

Kōgijin (the domain's delegate to the Kōgisho, the public deliberative assembly): the heading 公議人 with the name Kasama Einoshin; no count is printed. The heading aligns with the leftmost name column, not with 柴田津司馬, so this is the only name under the office.
公議人
